title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or Go, along with knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
description: Work on real-world engineering projects across Google's core products, collaborate with full-time mentors, and build scalable systems.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the UK applying for a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership potential, and commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Full-cost scholarships for postgraduate study in any subject available at the University of Cambridge for international students.

title: Associate Frontend Developer (Remote)
eligibility: Open to early-career developers worldwide with core web development experience.
qualification: Experience with JavaScript, Vue.js or React, HTML/CSS, and Git version control.
description: Help build, refine, and maintain GitLab's web applications in an all-remote, asynchronous work culture.

title: Junior Data Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of experience in quantitative fields.
qualification: Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Tableau/PowerBI, and analytical problem-solving skills.
description: Clean, model, and analyze complex business data to generate actionable strategic insights for enterprise clients.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university globally.
qualification: Working project prototype leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Microsoft Cloud services.
description: Global technology competition encouraging students to use cutting-edge AI technology to solve global challenges.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide, no prior programming experience required.
qualification: Basic computer literacy and interest in computer science fundamentals.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
